summary: Iteration 43 - Light/Dark Mode Toggle Testing Complete. All 12 features verified working. Theme toggle button visible in main Navbar and Pulse Portal headers. Toggle correctly switches between sun/moon icons. Theme persists in localStorage and across page navigation. Hero section preserves white text on dark background in light mode. All text is readable in both modes across Homepage, Dashboard, and Pulse Portal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme toggle feature is fully functional. Default theme is dark. Theme is stored in localStorage('theme') and applied via data-theme attribute on <html>. CSS custom properties handle all color transitions. Hero section uses data-hero-section attribute to preserve white text in light mode.

1_theme_toggle_btn_navbar.notes: Theme toggle button (data-testid='theme-toggle-btn') visible in main Navbar with Sun icon in dark mode, Moon icon in light mode

2_theme_toggle_switches_mode.notes: Clicking toggle switches data-theme attribute between 'dark' and 'light'. Body background changes from rgb(10,10,10) to rgb(245,245,247)

3_theme_persists_navigation.notes: Theme persists across page navigation (Homepage → Features → Pricing → Dashboard). localStorage('theme') correctly stores value

4_hero_section_white_text.notes: Homepage hero section (data-hero-section) preserves white text (rgb(255,255,255)) even in light mode

5_homepage_feature_cards_readable.notes: How It Works and feature cards have dark text (rgb(24,24,27)) on light background in light mode

6_dashboard_light_mode_readable.notes: Dashboard title, KPI cards, tab labels all have dark text (rgb(24,24,27) or rgb(82,82,91)) on light backgrounds in light mode

7_dashboard_dark_mode_works.notes: Dashboard in dark mode has white text (rgb(255,255,255)) on dark backgrounds

8_pulse_portal_dark_mode.notes: Pulse Dashboard in dark mode: cards have dark bg (rgb(18,18,18)), text is light (rgb(250,250,250))

9_pulse_portal_light_mode.notes: Pulse Dashboard in light mode: cards have light bg, text is dark (rgb(24,24,27))

10_pulse_theme_toggle.notes: Pulse Dashboard header has theme toggle (data-testid='pulse-theme-toggle') that works correctly

11_navbar_links_readable.notes: All navbar links have readable color (rgb(82,82,91)) in light mode

12_login_button_visible.notes: Login button text is dark (rgb(24,24,27)) in light mode, not white-on-white

mobile_menu_light_mode.notes: Mobile menu links have readable color (rgb(82,82,91)) in light mode

pulse_landing_theme_toggle.notes: Pulse Landing page has theme toggle (data-testid='pulse-landing-theme-toggle') that works correctly
